objective: Induce and measure branchable RLM scaffold use on deterministic QASPER without conflating interface feasibility, scaffold induction, branch informativeness, or scientific credit comparisons.

history.v1_clean_result: The exact stock policy and v1 interface produced zero depth-one child calls in 32 natural episodes.
v1_confounds: Prompt requested FINAL(...) while the scorer parsed only a bare Python list.
The forced fixture demonstrated a top-level rlm tool although rlm is callable only inside IPython.

shared_byte_identical_fields: base checkpoint or selected SFT adapter
fairness.oracle_floor_trigger: Dropping either branch-global or local for a labeling-based design choice triggers configs/stage-c9/oracle-floor-trigger-v1.json.

order: independent eligible-target density and branch-informativeness audit
adaptive_cascade.fewshot_result_may_only: Select the already-frozen few-shot-pass or few-shot-fail branch.
adaptive_cascade.sft_fallback_freeze_deadline: Before the first few-shot support model output.
adaptive_cascade.consequence: No few-shot support model call is authorized by this design version.

interface_contract.answer_contract: After tool use, the root emits exactly one bare Python list of strings; FINAL(...) and prose are invalid.
interface_contract.child_invocation_inside_ipython: children = await asyncio.gather(*(rlm(prompt) for prompt in child_prompts))

eligible_target_contract.denominator: Every natural support rollout, including parse errors, timeouts, and zero-child traces.
eligible_target_contract.commitment: The selector commits before the child output/action is observed and consumes only structural PrefixFeatures.
required_exact_fields: pre-call restorable snapshot bytes and SHA-256
downstream provenance proving the child return entered later state or prompt

eligible_target_power.joint_pass_rule: At least 58 of 64 support rollouts must contain the one committed target and produce a reward-informative branch group under the exact planned K and deterministic reward.

anti_overuse_cost_band.p95_child_calls_and_tokens: Must be frozen after CPU ledger design and before support sampling.

live_preflights_required_before_support: real pinned renderer exposes only IPython and renders the exact shared prompt
first fixture IPython code literally executes await asyncio.gather over two rlm calls
two depth-one calls and exact return links are serialized
episode seeds, exact prompt/action tokens, checkpoint, decoding hash, and logprobs are present
pre-call snapshot restoration reproduces the original exactly
one alternative passes both full and sliced replay
miniature checkpoint-retention run physically preserves and reloads every requested adapter

missing_before_authorization: alternative branch continuation service time and tokens
few-shot repeated prompt-token and KV cost
budget.pass_rule: Feasibility, any SFT, all three scientific arms, artifact recovery, and teardown must fit the live wallet while retaining the reserve.

repair_and_stop.before_model_output: Outcome-independent deterministic integration fixes may be versioned and re-audited.
repair_and_stop.after_support_output: Never rerun the same task or seed. A demonstrated outcome-independent defect requires a distinct committed protocol and fresh support block.
repair_and_stop.after_first_sft_step: Resume only from a prevalidated full-state checkpoint before candidate support metrics; otherwise the SFT draw terminates.
repair_and_stop.after_candidate_score: Only the frozen earliest-pass selection is allowed.
terminal_before_training: few-shot and the predeclared SFT fallback both fail
checkpoint or adapter reload roundtrip fails
